summary: Stage 1-3 tested end to end on the public URL. Backend: new pytest file with 15 tests, all passing on the final run. Covered: cross-firm auth matrix (19 ops: B sending A's X-Project-Id gets 404 'Project not found for your business.' with no payload, A unchanged, anonymous gets 401), CORS (evil.example and null origins are not echoed; foreign-origin mutations get 403), logout revocation (old access, Bearer and refresh tokens get 401; signing in again works), the invite verify gate (403 VERIFY_EMAIL with no partner_access added; 5-attempt limit holds even for the correct code; works once verified), response race (409 on a superseded version with no response saved; duplicate key still returns duplicate:true), assistant explain/revise/question/'Fine with that'/stale 409/intake/injection/history isolation, Stripe checkout in test mode, and fulfil ignoring livemode=true (unit check). Frontend at 1920 and 390: left rail with counts, facts column with Current review/Private draft labels, chips, assistant panel and drawer, Synthetic badge on title, review and summary, 'Passes recorded checks', intake 409 kept-edits banner and Discard, review verify panel, .test email dialog showing 'Copy link instead', partner response showing after reload. Found 2 UI bugs, both fixed: 19px horizontal overflow at 390, and 'Read it as a source' crash. One assistant reliability issue is open: Claude sometimes replies in prose, not JSON.

minor.issue: Claude sometimes returns plain prose instead of the JSON object, so parse() returns None and the user gets mode 'error' ('I couldn't produce a usable answer'). Seen in 2 of 6 explain calls through the API and 1 of 3 direct LLM calls. One reply was prose followed by a ```json block, which parses only by luck. It is safe (no write), but explain fails often enough that users will notice.
apply_revision calls start_preview before validating edits (unknown sites, edit_preview errors). A revise request that then fails still leaves a new empty private draft open and bumps rev.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED: 'Read it as a source' threw 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading text)' and no source was created. Cause: the history GET on mount (fired twice) resolved after the optimistic user message was added, so msgs ended up as [reply] only and the user bubble disappeared. Now uses m.userText || userMsg?.text. The underlying race, where the history GET overwrites optimistic messages and drops the user bubble, is still there.
FIXED: at 390px the Assistant / Guided tour / Reset this example row did not wrap, so scrollWidth was 409. Added flex-wrap; scrollWidth is now 390.

integration_issues.flow: Assistant intake -> Read it as a source
integration_issues.issue: After a successful read there is no visible confirmation (no toast, no source status in the panel). The button just goes back to 'Read it as a source', so users may click it again and create duplicate sources.

design_issues.screen: Desktop right column facts card when a private draft exists
issues: The facts card is height-clipped: Conditions value and the next-action button are cut off and need an inner scroll.
A generic stale toast ('This sheet changed in another tab... Reload') appears together with the kept-edits banner. The toast's 'Reload' advice contradicts 'your edits are kept'.

action_items: Make the assistant robust to non-JSON output: retry once with a 'JSON only' reminder, or treat JSON-less prose as mode 'explain' (no write).
In apply_revision, validate edits before start_preview (or discard the preview on failure) so failed revisions don't leave an empty private draft.

AssistantPanel: don't let the mount history GET overwrite in-flight optimistic messages (merge by msg_id, or ignore a stale response after send); add a success toast/state after 'Read it as a source'.
Avoid clipping the facts card when a private draft row is added; suppress the generic stale toast when the intake kept-edits banner is shown.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: CORS_ORIGINS='*' resolves to an empty allow list. That is fine for same-origin, but any future separate frontend origin needs an explicit CORS_ORIGINS. origin_guard trusts X-Forwarded-Host, which the ingress sets.
verify_confirm counts attempts with find_one_and_update before comparing; a correct code after 5 failures is rejected (verified, correct behaviour).
review respond: the version check, the insert and the guarded update are correct; the compensating delete on a lost race works.
assistant_routes stores the user message before the LLM call, so failed or error replies still leave history; acceptable.

success_rate.backend: 100% (15/15 on final run; assistant explain flaky ~30%)

seed_data_creation: Registered TEST_ organizers test_{A,B,L,V}_<rand>@example.com (pilot_active set in Mongo) and invite users test-assemble-*@mailinator.com (email_verified set manually; no verification emails sent). No email sent to chosenvictor12@gmail.com.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run tests/test_stage123_security.py with -n 0. Assistant calls take 2-8s. The login UI is email-first (check-email); for non-demo users log in via page.request POST /api/auth/login, then navigate. Demo draft needs partner_ids alder/birch/cedar. The review verify panel hides the code input until 'Email me a code' is clicked (don't click it for real addresses).
rca of the issue: Read-as-source crash: AssistantPanel useEffect GET /project/assistant replaced msgs after the optimistic user msg was appended, so the reply had no preceding user message and userMsg was undefined. Assistant 'error' mode: the model ignores the JSON-only instruction for conversational questions (returns prose); parse() requires a {...} object.
